# jamfplatform_cbengine_benchmark (List Resource)

Searches for Jamf Compliance Benchmarks with an optional case-insensitive substring filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "jamfplatform_cbengine_benchmark" "cis_benchmarks" {
  provider = jamfplatform

  config {
    search = "CIS"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Optional substring to match (case-insensitive) against benchmark title or description.
